news.title: How much do you know about NATO? Take our quiz
news.summary_en: Test your NATO knowledge and see how you compare to U.S. adults. Americans answer half of five factual questions correctly, on average.

news.title: What Political Issues Do Americans Hear About in Church?
news.summary_en: Most U.S. adults who go to religious services say they’ve recently heard from their clergy about at least one political or social issue.

news.title: Trading volume on prediction markets has soared in recent months
news.summary_en: Prediction market trading volume has risen from under $5 billion monthly in mid 2025 to nearly $24 billion in April 2026, with sports dominating.

news.title: 10 facts about Americans and marijuana
news.summary_en: Nearly nine-in-ten U.S. adults say marijuana should be legal either for medical or recreational use. Just 11% say the drug should not be legal at all.
